title: Core parts are excluded from both the inventory and catalogue result sets
custom_preconds:
1. An inventory part flagged as a core has in-window sales activity and on-hand stock.
2. A vendor-sourced core part was requested on an invoiced/paid work order in the window.
custom_steps:
1. Search the report for the inventory core part (Type = Both).
2. Search for the catalogue core part.
custom_expected:
1. The inventory core part does NOT appear in the report despite its activity and stock.
2. The catalogue core part does NOT appear either.
3. Parts flagged as a core are excluded from both result sets by design.
